subject: ClosedComposition
summary: Specify closed composition invariants before implementing the snapshot representation.

content.change: Define ClosedComposition closure semantics, dependency pinning, occurrence identity and deterministic reconstruction contracts before implementing the record.
content.rationale: Reproducible composition snapshots require stable identities and revision selection; the original sketch does not itself specify these invariants.
constraints: Integrate with existing composition, revision, provenance and snapshot structures.
Do not mistake implementation behaviour for specification authority.
acceptance_criteria: Document formal closure and reconstruction invariants with failure cases.
Specify closure and reconstruction operation preconditions, postconditions and tests.
Obtain owner review before treating architectural choices as approved.
open_questions: Does closure mean dependency-pinned or fully self-contained?
How is occurrence identity maintained across structural edits?
Which resources are within the initial text-only closure boundary?
